question_text: Describe how you keep walkways safe.
expected_answer: You remove obstacles keep floors clear and ensure paths are easy to navigate

question_text: Explain how you handle a small spill.
expected_answer: You clean it immediately mark the area and confirm the floor is dry

question_text: Describe how you lift a light object safely.
expected_answer: You bend your knees keep your back straight and lift with your legs

question_text: Explain how you store items safely.
expected_answer: You place heavy items low secure unstable objects and avoid overloading shelves

question_text: Describe how you keep your workspace safe.
expected_answer: You organize materials remove clutter and follow basic safety rules

question_text: Explain how you handle a minor hazard.
expected_answer: You address it quickly report it if needed and make the area safe

question_text: Describe how you use basic protective equipment.
expected_answer: You wear required gear check fit and replace damaged items

question_text: Explain how you avoid simple electrical hazards.
expected_answer: You keep cords intact avoid water and unplug devices properly

question_text: Describe how you stay safe around moving equipment.
expected_answer: You keep distance stay alert and follow posted warnings

question_text: Explain how you report a small safety concern.
expected_answer: You notify the proper person describe the issue and follow instructions
